page-structure.evidence: Page title is 'Reacher' — single-word brand name, not descriptive of purpose (2.4.2 fail). No lang attribute on <html> (axe html-has-lang, serious; language of page unidentifiable by AT — 3.1.1 A). No landmark regions at all (landmarkCount=0, axe region fires on every content block); no <main>, no <nav>, no <header> semantic element — navigation is a fixed <div> (1.3.1). Heading hierarchy is severely broken: page starts with H2s before any H1, has H5/H4 mix mid-page (axe heading-order, moderate), and many H2s used for numeric statistics (+200%, 300K+) that are metric values, not section headings. H1 appears multiple times and mid-page ('Trusted by top brands', 'Why Reacher is the Obvious Choice', '#1 on TikTok Shop App Store', etc.) — outline has no logical parent–child structure.

grouping-and-reading-order.evidence: Fixed nav bar (div.framer-r5ccev-container) is DOM child #3 of the root, AFTER the main content wrapper (div.framer-jx0221) and banner. Tab walk confirms: stops 0–39 traverse all content sections, stops 40–46 reach the nav, then stops 47–49 hit the footer. Visually the nav is at the top of every viewport, but keyboard and SR users must read through the entire page before reaching it — DOM order ≠ visual order (1.3.2). No skip-to-main link present. One <ul> with list-style:none and no role='list' attribute (12 items, testimonials carousel) — VoiceOver/Safari will strip list semantics (1.3.1, WebKit-specific).

reflow.evidence: At 320×900: scrollWidth=404 vs clientWidth=320 (ratio 1.26). Overflowing elements include general layout DIVs (framer-fgZId, framer-jx0221, framer-62al27-container) and a CANVAS element — the layout itself overflows, not an exempt data table or map. Page body renders (bodyLen=5495). 1.4.10 fail.

issues.evidence: Page title is 'Reacher' — single word brand name, not descriptive of page purpose.
Missing lang attribute on <html> element — language of page unidentifiable by AT.
No landmark regions (main, nav, header, footer) — landmarkCount=0, no semantic structure for AT navigation.
Heading hierarchy is broken: page starts with H2s, H5/H4 appear mid-page before H2 context, H1 appears multiple times out of sequence (heading-order axe violation).
At 320px viewport: scrollWidth=404 vs clientWidth=320. General layout overflows (DIVs, CANVAS). Not an exempt data table or map.
Fixed nav bar is DOM-last (after all page content). Tab walk confirms nav is reached at stops 40–46, after all body content. No skip-to-main link. Visual order ≠ DOM/focus order.
Testimonial carousel <ul> with list-style:none and no role='list' (12 li items) — VoiceOver/Safari strips list semantics.
Logo/TikTok icon link has no accessible name — SVG with no aria-label, no title, no text content. Announced as bare 'link' to screen readers.
Custom tab 'Retain' (tabindex=0): role=generic, no aria-selected, no aria-controls. Interactive control without semantic role.
Custom tab 'Outreach' (tabindex=0): role=generic, no ARIA role/state. Same as Retain.
Custom tab 'Optimize' (tabindex=0): role=generic, no ARIA role/state. Same as Retain/Outreach.
H4 'Retain' (Inactive state): rgba(53,89,233,0.59) composited on rgb(241,245,253) = 2.49:1 vs 3:1 large-text threshold (20px bold). Fail.
H5 'Outreach' (Inactive): rgb(158,163,191) on rgb(249,250,251) = 2.38:1 vs 3:1 large-text threshold (20px). Fail.
H5 'Optimize' heading: rgb(158,163,191) on rgb(249,250,251) = 2.38:1 vs 3:1 large-text threshold (20px). Fail.
